attacks.charter: Explore the HTTP code pattern with Unicode digits to find stderr text copied into the note
attacks.input: stderr 'HTTP ARABIC-INDIC 303 and HTTP FULLWIDTH 403' through _forge_failure
attacks.expected: no code appended: only an ASCII three-digit code is a code
attacks.observed: gh exited with status 1 (HTTP <arabic-indic digits>): \d in a str pattern matches any Unicode digit, so three attacker chosen characters reach the note

seeds.title: _forge_failure copies Unicode digits as the HTTP code
seeds.detail: The pattern \bHTTP(?:/\d(?:\.\d)?)? (\d{3})\b uses str mode, so \d matches Arabic-Indic and fullwidth digits. Stderr 'HTTP ٣٠٣' gives 'gh exited with status 1 (HTTP ٣٠٣)'. Leak is at most three digit characters, so no token leaks, but the plan says 'one exact three-digit code'. Fix: re.ASCII flag or [0-9].
